summary: ClamAV location is next to the executable, so cargo tauri dev reports the engine unavailable unless copied by hand
evidence: platform/src/lib.rs:31-33 current_exe().parent()/clamav/clamscan.exe; dev binary lives in target/debug
failure_scenario: Developer runs cargo tauri dev with ClamAV installed elsewhere: the scan button stays disabled. Not documented in the code read; README not checked.
resolution_note: Owner sign-off 2026-11-18 (decision D7): ClamAV is not used; the engine is replaced per ADR 0004 (proposed). Finding concerns the clamscan/freshclam integration.
